REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - DECEMBER 10, 2015 - CITY HALL -
7:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
AGENDA MATERIALS: Reports and materials related to items on this Agenda are available for public inspection at the City Clerk's Office, Cerritos City Hall, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1248. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's Office at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS: For all Agenda Items, except for Consent Calendar Items, public comments will be allowed at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered. The general public comments portion of the meeting, under Agenda Item 6, will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate responses, persons are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record.
PUBLIC HEARINGS: Public hearings will be conducted in the order indicated on the agenda, unless otherwise directed. Please complete and submit a blue Speakers Card if you wish to present testimony. Conduct of public hearings will occur in substantially the following sequence: the item to be heard is announced, a report of written correspondence and staff report are received, and the City Council asks questions of staff. The public hearing is opened and verbal testimony will occur in the following order: the applicant, if applicable, those in favor, opposed, or interested parties, and rebuttal by applicant. Speakers are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record. After verbal testimony, the public hearing is closed and the matter is deliberated with a determination being made or a continuation of the matter.

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD ON
DECEMBER 10, 2015, IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS AT CERRITOS CITY HALL, 18125
BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Dr. Bill Ebling, First Baptist Church of Fullerton.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Brownie Troop #1043.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Jim Edwards
  Council/Agency Member Mark E. Pulido
  Council/Agency Member Naresh Solanki
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair George Ray
  Mayor/Chair Carol Chen

5.  Presentations/Appointments

  Hal Arbogast, Director of Public Works/City Engineer (Retirement)

7.  Consent Calendar

  motion. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless a Council/Agency
  Member or citizen so requests, in which event the item will be removed from the
  Consent Calendar and considered separately.

  2015 (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Edwards, and seconded by Ray, to approve the Register of
  Demands for the City of Cerritos dated December 10, 2015 in the total amount of
  $4,958,313.78 (COUNCIL). The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration of a contract for Cerritos Center for the Performing Arts design

  A staff report was given by Hal Arbogast, Director of Public Works/City Engineer.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected to speak,
  the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Solanki, and seconded by Edwards, to:

  1.  Award a contract for CCPA roof replacement design services to Plump
  Engineering Inc./D7 Consulting in an amount not to exceed $43,498; and

  modifications that may be necessary to complete the specified scope of work
  (COUNCIL).

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen

9C.  Consideration of consent to the assignment of a ground lease and approval of an
  estoppel certificate in connection with the assignment of the referenced ground lease
  interests from Arden Reality Limited Partnership, a Maryland partnership, to BRE
  Cerritos Officer Owner LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, which is a wholly
  owned  subsidiary  of  Blackstone  Real  Estate  (APN  7030-011-012)
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  A staff report was given by Kristin Aguila, Advanced Planning Manager. A PowerPoint
  Presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected to
  speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Edwards, and seconded by Ray, to authorize the City
  Manager/Executive Director to execute the document(s) to facilitate, acknowledge and
  consent to the transfer of the ground lease (APN 7030-011-012) of the commercial
  component of Arden Realty Limited Partnership (Arden Realty), a Maryland Limited
  Partnership to BRE Cerritos Officer Owner LLC (BRE Cerritos), a Delaware limited liability
  Company, which is a wholly owned subsidiary of Blackstone Real Estate (BRE), in such
  form as the City Manager shall deem appropriate, including any estoppel certificates,
  assignment consent, or related implementing documentation required to appropriate in
  connection with completion of such assignment. (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY). The
  motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  None.

10B.  Review and consideration to support or oppose specific legislation in the State or

  None.

11.  City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings

  CONSENSUS (Chen): Direct staff to provide a memorandum with a five year
  incremental statistic breakdown on the average daily traffic counts and collisions
  (separating out rear end collisions versus regular collisions) at City red light
  camera intersections (Artesia/Bloomfield and Gridley/South streets).

  CONSENSUS (Chen): Direct the Cerritos Planning Commission to conduct a
  study session to determine if additional garage parking should be required for
  large residential additions and to report said findings to the City Council for
  consideration and subsequent direction.

  CONSENSUS (Chen): Direct staff to conduct a citywide comprehensive study on
  the condition of street and median signs, and include the necessary replacement
  expenditures in the upcoming 2016-17 City Budget.

  Reports were provided by Mayor Chen, Mayor Pro Tem Ray, and Councilmembers
  Solanki, Pulido and Edwards.

12.  Closed Session

  None.

13.  Adjournment

  The meeting was adjourned in memory of Richard Jerome Coleman at 8:03 p.m.
